title: 学年 (classes)
description: A 学年 is created automatically the first time someone is assigned to it. It's numbered by the year the class finishes 6th grade (2016 = 第5期), and its grade and graduation update on their own each April. You can adjust years or delete unused classes.
cannotDelete: Classes with members, representatives or sent notifications can't be deleted.
members: {count, plural, =0 {No members} one {1 member} other {# members}}

hints.endChangesNumber: Changing this changes the class number.

errors.forbidden: You don't have permission to do that.
errors.yearsOrder: The end year must be after the start year.
errors.beforeFirst: 第1期 finished 6th grade in 2012; earlier years aren't valid.

emptyHint: A class is created automatically the first time a member picks it when applying or in their profile.

reps.title: Class reps
reps.hint: Choose from this 学年's students and graduates. Class reps can send notices to their 学年 and join the 学年代表 chat.
reps.search: Search this 学年's students and graduates
reps.noResults: No matching members in this 学年.
